PromptShield is a local privacy and security pre-check—not a full antivirus, sandbox, reputation database, or guarantee. Review every result.

    


    
THREE PRACTICAL CHECKS
Know what the tool can do
01
Aa
Prompt & text privacy
Detect and redact common emails, phone numbers, CNICs, cards, IP addresses, API keys and secret-filled URLs.
02
▧
File pre-check & cleaning
Inspect filenames and supported text/code content, explain risky patterns, then create a cleaned local copy.
03
↗
Link signal check
Spot unsafe protocols, lookalike domains, short links, hidden redirects, tracking and exposed secrets—without visiting the link.


    
ACCOUNT SAFETY CHECKLIST
Protect the account around the browser
Use this local checklist for GitHub, Fiverr, LinkedIn and other accounts. PromptShield never asks for passwords, recovery codes, cookies, or account access.

ABOUT PROMPTSHIELD
Useful protection, honest boundaries.
PromptShield AI is a free, open-source browser utility by Syed Areeb Ali under AI Tool Insider. It helps people catch visible privacy leaks and suspicious patterns before sharing content, opening links, or trusting a file.
  • ✓Runs locally with no server upload or analytics payload
  • ✓Explains each warning in clear English or Roman Urdu
  • !Does not replace trusted antivirus, OS updates, backups, or account security controls
security-model.js
// Safety boundary
content.uploaded  // false
file.executed     // false
link.visited      // false
account.accessed  // false

// You stay in control
result.explained  // true
review.required   // true
